title: The call window looks like a call — video tiles, initials when the camera is off, an icon control bar, a real pre-join

tasks.title: Tiles with initials, an icon control bar, and a real pre-join

acs.text: WHILE in a call THE SYSTEM SHALL show each participant as a 16:10 tile on a dark background: their camera filling it when on, otherwise a circle with their initials; their name (and "you") on a label at the tile's bottom, a muted mark when their microphone is off, and a ring while they speak

WHILE in a call THE SYSTEM SHALL show the controls as one bar of round icon buttons, each with its accessible name (Microphone, Camera, Share screen), showing on and off apart (`aria-pressed` and a crossed icon when off), and Leave call as a red button at the bar's end

WHEN the pre-join step shows THE SYSTEM SHALL show a 16:10 preview area (the camera when on, otherwise "Your camera is off"), the microphone and camera as the same icon toggles, the device choosers as labelled selects, Join as the primary button and Cancel beside it; "Start audio" SHALL be a full-width notice button
